reviewMode: Independent read-only six-source review and retained raw portable evidence verification. No tests/grammar/Swift compiler/SDK, Git, cloud, credentials or JAR actions were performed.
disposition: No confirmed blocking finding in the prepared six-source delta. Ready for exact canonical integration and one bounded producer-only macOS attempt; actual macOS success and the previous codesign failure root cause remain unproven.

producerReview.evidence: The original first importer/partition commands remain. A second actual invocation of the same compiled importer receives operation=reopenIdentity, the existing owned Keychain path/password and public leaf/root certificates through private stdin, with empty PKCS12 fields. It opens only that file, explicitly unlocks it, observes prior/final status and enumerates legacy sign-use identities with a bounded limit and exact leaf match. The existing SecItem-based stored identity/root checks and genuine key sign/verify challenge are reused. No new key/certificate/owner, default search list or trust-database change is introduced.

The new schema2 reporter requires exact key membership, stage/operation, Int32 OSStatus, sole identity counts, exact public SHA256 shape, actual signature/read/write/unlock facts and codesignACLExecutionVerified=false. Malformed output is suppressed into fixed typed public failure fields; arbitrary child stdout/stderr, stdin and exception text are not forwarded. Actual child nonzero exit remains failure even if its reporter claims passed.

Reopen success is never a codesign success substitute. The next original codesign still executes and its actual nonzero exit/public stderr fail the producer. Original fixed certificate/identity/signing route and four detached CMS OpenSSL checks remain. The observed specified-item-not-found cause is not identified by source review, import success or the private-key challenge.

All existing per-tool budgets, the 300-second internal producer deadline, real child timeout/return status and separate 10-second owned-Keychain cleanup remain. The new finite outer producer command is bounded at 600 seconds and the workflow at 20 minutes. Process/error reporter fields remain accurate evidence of failure rather than a successful substitute.

finiteEntryReview.evidence: The separate reader-owned-sdk prefix derives exactly SHA[:7]. Validation requires GITHUB_SHA == actual checkout source, exact GITHUB_REF_NAME and GITHUB_REF, actual peeled tag commit and source-only mode. All 17 necessary workflow/runner/guard/fixture/producer/source files are compared with exact Git HEAD bytes. Each command phase records/checks the complete same before/after source table, and final source is checked again.

Toolchain selection, xcode version, SDK path and the same canonical generator use fixed argv and finite budgets. capture_phase stores actual command output/err bytes/hash, exit/timeout/oversize state and source facts. verify_pass demands the same phase order, argv/budget/toolchain, on-disk phase rows and unmodified public logs. Actual portable guards must be success. An error records first failure and blocked remaining phases, and removes any successful result if final source/failure invalidates it.

The raw producer path and pending public-copy path are siblings outside both exact artifact roots. stage_public first invokes the existing complete source/structure/hash/allowlist validator on raw outputs, refuses prior destination, copies only allowlisted names to the pending sibling, invokes the same validator again and renames into sdk-produced-public only on equality. A failed pending verification leaves no published directory; leftover pending storage is not uploaded or falsely claimed cleaned.

The new job does no App build/XCTest/SwiftPM/native verifier/simulator/JNI/device/account/install work and explicitly records nativeMethodsExecuted=0. Its prefix cannot trigger the unchanged reader-renewal tag filter. The existing full workflow, renewal tools and wrapper still match the prepared immutable 9105b46 hashes, so the old 253-definition/255-leaf gate was neither reduced nor accepted by this entry.

limitations: Actual Mac Swift import/typecheck, deprecated Security API availability and semantics, real reopen/unlock/legacy search, codesign and full producer execution remain zero for the new source. Grammar is not compilation.
One bounded producer-only tag is necessary to get the actual next evidence. A fresh importer or unlock observation cannot itself prove the original codesign error repaired.

Public staging validates source, structure, raw hashes, allowlist and command evidence; it does not execute the Swift CMS verifier or any native method. Only a successful generator path supplies four actual OpenSSL CMS checks.
The full native253/255 gate, App/JNI/real account/install/cold preservation and automatic renewal remain separate unfinished acceptance.
